exodus: Moses, the plagues and the parting of the Red Sea
leviticus: Priestly laws and rituals, third book of the Torah
numbers: Two censuses and forty years of wandering in the desert
deuteronomy: Moses' farewell speeches, fifth book of the Torah
joshua: The walls of Jericho come tumbling down
ruth: A Moabite widow tells her mother-in-law "Where you go, I will go"
1-samuel: Hannah's son anoints Saul; David defeats Goliath
1-kings: Solomon's wisdom and temple; Elijah on Mount Carmel
2-kings: Elijah taken up in a whirlwind; the fall of Jerusalem
1-chronicles: Genealogies from Adam, then David's reign retold
2-chronicles: Solomon to the exile, retold from the temple's view
ezra: A scribe leads exiles home to rebuild the temple
esther: A Jewish queen of Persia saves her people; never mentions God
job: A righteous man loses everything and questions God
psalms: The 150 songs, including "The Lord is my shepherd"
proverbs: Wise sayings attributed mostly to Solomon
song-of-solomon: Love poetry between a bride and her beloved
isaiah: Major prophet: "Comfort ye my people"; foretells a child called Immanuel
jeremiah: The "weeping prophet" who warned Judah before Babylon
lamentations: Five poems mourning the fall of Jerusalem
ezekiel: Prophet with a vision of a valley of dry bones
daniel: The lions' den and the writing on the wall
hosea: Prophet told to marry an unfaithful wife as a sign
joel: Prophet of a locust plague and "your old men shall dream dreams"
amos: Shepherd prophet: "Let justice roll down like waters"
obadiah: The shortest Old Testament book, against Edom
jonah: The prophet swallowed by a great fish
micah: Prophet who named Bethlehem as the ruler's birthplace
nahum: Prophet who foretold the fall of Nineveh
habakkuk: Prophet who argues with God: "the righteous shall live by faith"
zephaniah: Prophet of the coming "day of the Lord"
haggai: Prophet urging the rebuilding of the temple after the exile
zechariah: Prophet of night visions; a king riding on a donkey
malachi: The last book of the Old Testament
matthew: First gospel, written by a tax collector; Sermon on the Mount
luke: Gospel by a physician, with the Good Samaritan and Prodigal Son
john: Gospel that opens "In the beginning was the Word"
romans: Paul's longest letter, to the church in the empire's capital
1-corinthians: Paul's letter with the "love is patient, love is kind" chapter
2-corinthians: Paul's second letter to Corinth, about his "thorn in the flesh"
galatians: Paul's letter about the fruit of the Spirit
ephesians: Paul's letter about "the full armour of God"
philippians: Paul's joyful letter: "I can do all things through Christ"
colossians: Paul's letter to a church at Colossae about Christ's supremacy
1-thessalonians: Paul's earliest letter, about the second coming
2-thessalonians: Paul's follow-up letter: "if anyone will not work, let him not eat"
1-timothy: Paul's first pastoral letter to his young protégé in Ephesus
2-timothy: Paul's last letter: "I have fought the good fight"
titus: Paul's pastoral letter to a leader in Crete
philemon: Paul's short letter about the runaway slave Onesimus
hebrews: Anonymous letter with the "hall of faith" chapter
james: Letter saying "faith without works is dead"
1-peter: Letter of hope for Christians suffering persecution
2-peter: Letter warning of false teachers: "a day is like a thousand years"
2-john: Very short letter to "the elect lady"
3-john: The shortest book in the Bible by verses, to Gaius
jude: One-chapter letter just before the last book
revelation: The final book: the four horsemen and the New Jerusalem
